paragraphs: My name is Tom, and I am twelve years old. On Monday, I saw a big poster at the school gate. It said, "School Fun Day. Saturday, the fourteenth of November. Where: the school hall and the field. Follow the green arrows." Coach Matt stood next to the poster. "Come and spend a good day with us," he said. "It will not be boring!" "Do you want to go?" asked Ben. "Yes, I do," I said.

Under that, there was a timetable. It said, "Ten o'clock: History corner in the hall. Eleven o'clock: Football on the field. Half past one: Show on the stage. Three o'clock: The end." The timetable has four times and four things to do. "Look at the history corner," said Ben. "There are old photos of our school." I wanted my friend Hugo to come too.

That night, I wrote a short note to Hugo. I wrote it on clean white paper with my best pen. "Dear Hugo, Come to the School Fun Day on Saturday. Meet me at the school gate at ten o'clock. We will see the history corner and play football. Your friend, Tom" I gave the note to Hugo at school on Tuesday. He read it and smiled.

"I will come," said Hugo. "I like football, and I like history too." On Saturday, we met at the gate at ten o'clock. We followed the green arrows to the hall. In the afternoon, we sat near the stage and watched the show. It was not boring at all. Then we clapped for all the children on the stage. A poster tells us what, where, and when.
